hero.video.label: 63-second intro video
hero.video.desc: What the video shows:
things you find online
end up scattered across
bookmarks, screenshots,
downloads and chat windows.
A page, a selection, an image
or one AI reply:
one click drops it into a folder
on your own computer,
sorted by topic.
No server, no account.
Then Claude Code, Codex
or Gemini CLI reads that folder,
with a source for every item.
